regime_context: The detector shows a clear Precious Metals leadership cluster (Gold Miners and Silver & Royalties nearly tied, both trend-eligible with strong durability and full breadth) atop an otherwise mixed TSX sector board. Nine of sixteen themes pass the absolute-trend gate (frac 0.56), and the validated gate has helped on this market in out-of-sample (drawdown control), but the detector itself carries no return-forecast edge — momentum rank is a focus lens only.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Base Metals & Copper (rank 3, score 1.228, eligible, durability 0.63) closes the gap to the Precious Metals cluster. The condition that would retire this watch: Base Metals & Copper durability_bar exceeds 0.75 AND score moves within 0.5 of Gold Miners, confirming a genuine second metals leadership rather than a follower bounce.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners lead the board with the highest momentum score and durability (0.78), are trend-eligible (Hurst 'trend'), show full breadth (1.0), and are not crowded (z 0.67). The trend-gate leg is the only validated edge, and this theme passes it. The lean is therefore to stay with the confirmed leader while the gate holds, not a new return forecast.
theses.dissent: Gold is already the dominant narrative (one_narrative false but leader large), and momentum rank has ~0 forward edge — the top rank may mark a late-stage attention peak rather than continued upside; an ETF-proxy drawdown would be painful even with alpha absent.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO breaks below its 50-day absolute-trend gate and stays there for 5 consecutive sessions before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Silver & Royalties is statistically tied with Gold Miners (score 2.155 vs 2.158) and also trend-eligible with strong durability (0.72) and full breadth. It forms the second leg of the precious-metals complex that is dominating leadership. Leaning with the complex while the gate holds is the only reasonable conditional.
theses.dissent: Hurst is 'mixed' not 'trend', so the trend-gate support is weaker than Gold's; a silver-specific squeeze or industrial-demand wobble could decouple it from gold even as gold stays firm.

falsifier.text: XGD.TO (silver royalty proxy) lags XGD.TO gold miners by more than 5% cumulative over any 10-session window before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas Producers is trend-eligible but crowded (crowding_z 1.2, the only crowded theme on the board) with a 'mixed' Hurst tag. The crowding flag is a size-down caution only, never a fade, but with no validated forward edge on crowding and momentum rank-IC ~0, the lean is to avoid new exposure here while the crowded condition persists.
evidence: rank 5, eligible true but crowded true (z 1.2)
theses.dissent: Energy has macro-narrative tailwinds (unscheduled geopolitics share 0.97, energy headlines) and breadth 1.0 — crowding may simply reflect strong fundamentals, and avoiding it could miss continuation.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO crowding_z drops below 0.5 AND durability_bar crosses above 0.75 while remaining trend-eligible before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
